Author: Techdamentals
Text: $V Worth separating the rails from the lenders this earnings season. A card network moves the transaction and takes a cut of the volume. It does not lend the money. When a borrower stops paying, that is not the network's loss. The bank that issued the card earns interest on the balance and absorbs the loss if it goes bad. Provisions, the cash set aside against loans expected to sour, rose at three separate institutions this quarter. A network carries none of that line, which is why grouping both under financials hides more than it explains.
